name: Millbury Street at McKeon Road: impassable
quote: In the southern part of Worcester, cars were stuck in flood waters at Millbury Street and McKeon Road.

name: Dale Street: flooded to car windshields
quote: In Worcester, flash flood waters were up to car windshields on Dale Street.

name: Dewey Street at Parker Street: impassable (five cars stuck)
quote: In Worcester, five cars were stuck in flood waters at Dewey Street and Parker Street.

name: Route 56 at Marshall Street: flooded with debris
quote: In Leicester, Route 56 at Marshall Street was flooded, with debris in the roadway.  May be because of the Kettle Brook.
